subject.title: fix(auth): count token-type profiles in provider health status rollup

question: Should the gateway model-auth status rollup accept token/setup-token profiles as the fallback when no effective OAuth profile exists?
rationale: The patch is bounded and well proven, but provider auth-status fallback behavior is compatibility-sensitive and changes what existing OAuth-configured setups report after migration.

options.title: Accept token fallback and land
options.body: Accept OAuth as primary while using token/setup-token status when no effective OAuth profile exists, then land after the remaining gates are clean.

options.title: Pause for a different boundary
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want token-only migrations handled by runtime/doctor policy or TUI suppression instead of gateway status projection.

recommendation.title: Accept token fallback and land
recommendation.body: Accept OAuth as primary while using token/setup-token status when no effective OAuth profile exists, then land after the remaining gates are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned on the PR and has the strongest history on token auth profiles, Anthropic setup-token behavior, and the current proof comment.
